thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, two text versions. Show the VIEWER living the moment, never a musician performing (6.11% vs 3.03% CTR). Pichwai/Kangra miniature, aged cream parchment, ornate border. Scene: night bedroom, a person deeply asleep on their side under a light quilt, face relaxed, moonlight through a carved window with the very first pale band of dawn at the horizon. description:
Fall Into Deep Sleep | Bansuri Instrumental | 3 Hours of Soft, Unbroken Rest

The day is over, but your body has not caught up yet. If you lie awake replaying conversations, or wake at 3am and cannot drift back, let this play quietly beside you.

This soft Indian flute music is designed to carry you down into deep sleep and keep the night gentle - flowing and soothing, never so slow that it feels empty.

Enjoy 3 hours of warm bansuri melodies over a continuous tanpura drone, with smooth transitions, no vocals and no sudden sounds to wake you.

Perfect for falling asleep, staying asleep, sleepless nights, light sleepers, afternoon naps, bedtime reading, calming a busy mind at night, children's bedtime, meditation before sleep, or quiet overnight background.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Durga (a gentle night raga)
Style: Indian classical ambient
Mood: Soft, safe, drifting
Atmosphere: A moonlit room and slow breathing
Duration: 3 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Start the music as you get into bed and set the volume just above silence. Let your breath lengthen with the flute. The music continues long after you fall asleep, so if you wake in the night it is still there to ease you back. Low speakers or comfortable sleep headphones both work well.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 The day lets go
15:00 Breath growing longer
30:00 Heavy, warm and safe
45:00 Drifting under
1:00:00 Deep, quiet waters
1:15:00 Slow moonlit drift
1:30:00 The still of the night
1:45:00 Deeper and softer
2:00:00 Held through the dark
2:15:00 Unbroken rest
2:30:00 Light, dreamless quiet
2:45:00 Gentle fade toward morning

⏱ BEST FOR
• Falling asleep faster
• Staying asleep through the night
• Sleepless or restless nights
• Light sleepers
• Calming a busy mind at bedtime
• Bedtime reading
• Naps and daytime rest
• Children's bedtime
• Meditation before sleep
• Waking up rested

If this music helped you sleep, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
